description: GOV-400 license inventory for the editor fonts in SparkEditor/Fonts. tools/governance/generate_third_party_notices.py reads it: every tracked font in the parent directory must have an entry; 'copyright' must equal the font's name-table copyright string (nameID 0); 'license' must agree with the font's name-table license description (nameID 13) when the font carries one; 'license_file' is the upstream license text, committed verbatim from 'license_source', and is reproduced in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. The directory is installed with the fonts (SparkEditor/CMakeLists.txt).
